[![A man cleans his boat at the Waskesiu Marina beside Waskesiu Lake in Prince Albert National Park.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/sk/princealbert/WET4/2024/ais/ais-640-24.jpg?modified=20240517210251)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/nature/conservation/aquatiques_aquatic) ### [Aquatic invasive species](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/nature/conservation/aquatiques_aquatic) All watercraft must have a mandatory aquatic invasive species (AIS) watercraft certification permit before entering Prince Albert National Park waters to help stop the spread of AIS. | | [How to get here](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/visit/directions) ### Contact Prince Albert National Park Phone number **General inquiries:** 1-306-663-4522 1-888-773-8888 (toll free) [princealbertinfo@pc.gc.ca](mailto:princealbertinfo@pc.gc.ca) **For emergencies within the park:** 1-877-852-3100 ### Hours of operation **Open all year round** Some services and facilities are open only during the summer season [See all hours](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/visit/heures-hours) ### \#PrinceAlbertNP - [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/PrinceAlbertNationalPark) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/sk/sk-grasslands-640.jpg?modified=20221126215444)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/grasslands) ### [Grasslands National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/grasslands) At Grasslands National Park, expanses of dinosaur fossils harken back to a time before history. Tipi rings are testament to First Nations communities, and ruins of prairie homesteads tell of settlers intent on taming the prairie. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/ab/ab-elk-island-pn-np-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126221034)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/elkisland) ### [Elk Island National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/elkisland) Experience first-hand the story of the bison and how it was saved from near extinction at Elk Island National Park, where an active conservation program replenishes herds around the world. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/sk/sk-batoche-640.jpg?modified=20221126215443)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/sk/batoche) ### [Batoche National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/sk/batoche) Experience life as a Métis settler in the village community of Batoche and discover the history of the last battle of the Northwest Rebellion/Resistance of 1885, scene of Louis Riel’s last stand. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/mb/pnmr-rmnp-2-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220835)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/mb/riding) ### [Riding Mountain National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/mb/riding) Explore 3000 km2 of thrilling outdoor possibilities in Riding Mountain National Park where the boreal forest, aspen parkland and fescue prairie meet. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/sk/sk-walsh-640.jpg?modified=20221126215444)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/sk/walsh) ### [Fort Walsh National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/sk/walsh) Experience life with James Morrow Walsh and his NWMP troops in the 1870s. Barter for buffalo robes at the trading post, smell sweet lodge pole pines on a hike through the Cypress Hills. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/sk/sk-motherwell-640.jpg?modified=20221126215444)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/sk/motherwell) ### [Motherwell Homestead National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/sk/motherwell) Hear prairie songbirds sing and smell the sweet hay as you help feed the horses. Re-connect with Canada’s homestead life and bake bread with flour ground from grain harvested from the golden fields outside. Date modified : 2026-11-03

# Trail conditions at Prince Albert National Park

## Prince Albert National Park

Whether you’re out for a leisurely hike or a longer adventure, make your trip a safe one by checking the latest conditions.

Seeing [wildlife](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/securite-safety/animaux-sauvages-wildlife) in their natural environment is a vacation highlight for most visitors. For your safety, the safety of others and the safety of bears, [be bear aware](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/securite-safety/ours-bear).

Exploring the scenic isolation of a national park can be invigorating, and it can also be challenging. [Prepare](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/securite-safety) for each park adventure!

# Camping

## Prince Albert National Park

## Most requested

- [You Are in Black Bear Country](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/securite-safety/ours-bear)
- [Emergency Planning](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/securite-safety/urgences-emergency)

All watercraft must have a [mandatory aquatic invasive species (AIS) watercraft certification permit](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/activ/experiences/activites-nautiques-water-activities/certification-embarcation-watercraft-certification) before entering Prince Albert National Park waters to help stop the spread of AIS.

Prince Albert National Park offers a wide range of camping from fully serviced and primitive (non-serviced) vehicle accessible campgrounds to simpler “get back to nature” backcountry campgrounds.

Review all [camping safety, regulations and etiquette](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/activ/camping/securite-safety) before departure.

### Parks Canada Reservation Service

Planning ahead is one of the best ways to make the most of each camping experience. Travel with peace of mind, visit the [Parks Canada Reservation Service](https://parks.canada.ca/voyage-travel/reserve) to pre-book a campsite. (Beaver Glen and Red Deer Campgrounds only).

**Reserve by phone:**

Call 1-877-RESERVE (1-877-737-3783). Available from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. local park time

Outside of North America: (519) 826-5391

If you would like more general information, please call the Parks Canada national information line at 1-888-773-8888.

[Reserve online](https://reservation.pc.gc.ca/)

#### Prince Albert National Park Camping Fees

- [Camping fees](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/princealbert/visit/tarifs-fees#camping) support the visitor services and facilities within Prince Albert National Park.

#### Hotels, suites, and cabins

Would you like to explore the wilderness of a national park without missing any of the comforts of home? The town of Waskesiu offers visitors a variety of commercial accommodations. For more information visit the [Waskesiu Chamber of Commerce](https://www.waskesiu.org/accommodations).
